text:
amanda: Hey — running the starter app with an Azure AD app-only token and the first call never succeeds. It loops refreshing the token and then we get a 403 with a payg gating message even though the workspace shows billing enabled. Anyone seen this?

amanda: logs:```
msal: acquiring token for client_id=abc...
msal: no refresh_token present (app-only)
2026-03-22T18:05:12Z caller=client.go status=403 msg="billing: workspace_unprovisioned"
2026-03-22T18:05:12Z caller=retries.go attempt=3 err="403 billing: workspace_unprovisioned"
```

jia: are you using app-only / client credentials flow (service principal) or a user delegated token? also which quickstart + language?

amanda: app-only (client credentials), starter-node quickstart. I exchanged token with MSAL (client secret). The token has azp, aud, sub but no email.

samir: FYI: our provisioning check expects either an org-scoped claim or a user email to map to a workspace + billing. app-only tokens often miss email. If no mapping found we return workspace_unprovisioned which surfaces as the 403 payg gate.

ryan: this is related to the change last week to tighten payg gating. If caller doesn't assert org identity we fallback to org lookup by email. app-only -> no email -> fail. We should accept an explicit header. Workaround: send x-redwood-org with the org id or use an org-scoped token.

amanda: can confirm adding header fixed it for me. curl example:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "x-redwood-org: org_01FZX9"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"hi"}'
```

jia: thanks — we should document that for app-only AAD flows and add a clearer error (currently it's just workspace_unprovisioned). Can we also make SDKs surface a specific error code for "missing org mapping"?

samir: opening ticket INF-4821 to add: clearer error message + docs + SDK header helper. assigning to devex.

ryan: note for prod: we shouldn't require headers long-term. We'll investigate mapping service principals to orgs automatically (servicePrincipal -> org binding).

amanda: for anyone hitting this: temp fix is x-redwood-org header or use a user token. Verified first-call success after adding header.

devex-bot: deploy: payg-provisioning-guard v1.3.2 rolled out to prod at 2026-03-22T17:30:00Z — this tightened identity checks.

jia: follow-up — i'll add a short note in quickstart AAD section and a sample snippet for node/msal.

amanda: awesome, thanks all. :thumbsup:
